item.title: West Azerbaijan Community addresses US Vice President ahead of Azerbaijan visit
item.description: The Western Azerbaijan Community has issued a statement addressed to US Vice President James David Vance regarding his upcoming visit to Azerbaijan.

item.title: Azerbaijani judokas finish Grand Slam tournament with 3 medals
item.description: Azerbaijani judoka Zelim Tchkayev won a silver medal at the "Grand Slam" tournament held in the French capital, Paris.

item.title: Coca-Cola signs new football partnership with Irish FA and NIFL
item.description: The Coca-Cola Company and its strategic bottling partner, Coca-Cola HBC Ireland and Northern Ireland, have agreed a new soft drinks partnership with the Irish Football Association (Irish FA) and the Northern Ireland Football League (NIFL).

item.title: Milan park mirrors Olympic spirit: Visitors reflect on true meaning of sport
item.description: Milan, the host city for the upcoming Olympic Games, has launched an unusual public art initiative inviting visitors to contemplate the deeper meaning of sport.

item.title: Peace at fragile hour: why Armenia’s court ruling risks Baku-Yerevan reconciliation
item.description: At moments of fragile peace, symbolism often matters as much as substance. Legal decisions are rarely just legal, timing is almost never accidental, and gestures aimed at domestic audiences tend to echo well beyond national borders.

item.title: Morgan McSweeney steps down following political storm over Mandelson
item.description: Morgan McSweeney has stepped down as the United Kingdom Prime Minister’s chief of staff following a growing political storm linked to former cabinet minister Peter Mandelson.

item.title: India detains three oil tankers in major smuggling bust
item.description: India’s Coast Guard has detained three oil tankers on suspicion of illegal oil smuggling, foreign media reported.

item.title: Two more teams secure qualification for Chovken World Championship
item.description: The South American Chovken Championship has concluded in Argentina amid a magnificent sporting atmosphere, determining the next teams to qualify for the World Championship, Azernews reports.

item.title: Community condemns provocative actions undermining Azerbaijan–Armenia normalization
item.description: The West Azerbaijan Community has strongly condemned recent steps taken in Armenia and several other countries that it says are aimed at undermining the Azerbaijan–Armenia normalization process.

item.title: Next court hearing in Ruben Vardanyan case set for February 10
item.description: The date of the next court session in the criminal case against Armenian citizen Ruben Vardanyan has been announced.
